title: DNA Extraction Procedure Using SDS
author: Jiang Hu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jg4cjyw

steps.title: Grind tissue with liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue and grind it in liquid nitrogen until a fine powder is obtained.

steps.title: Transfer ground tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the ground tissue into a 15 ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Incubate homogenate
steps.instruction: Incubate the homogenate for 2 h at 56 °C, gently blending the mixture every 5–10 min.

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the tube to cool down to room temperature (≥16 °C).

steps.title: Add chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: Add chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1) to the supernatant and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at >16 °C, 14 000 rpm for 10 min and retain the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet with 0.8 × the pellet volume of frozen isopropyl alcohol.

steps.title: Add TEN and RNase
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl TEN buffer and 2 µl RNase (100 mg ml⁻¹) to the suspension.

steps.title: Add SDS and Protease K
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl 20 % SDS (in TEN) and 40 µl Protease K, then bring the total volume up to 2 ml.

steps.title: Add EB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 300 µl EB buffer (pH 8.0) to dissolve the mixture.

steps.title: Add TEN, SDS, β‑mercaptoethanol, proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents and mix rapidly:

steps.title: Add Tris‑saturated phenol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Tris‑saturated phenol to the mixture and mix.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at >16 °C, 14 000 rpm for 10 min and keep the supernatant.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1) to the supernatant and mix.

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 10 min and retain the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash (twice)
steps.instruction: Wash the supernatant with cold 75 % ethanol twice (first wash, then second wash).

steps.title: Precipitation at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min to precipitate DNA, then dissolve the precipitate completely.

steps.title: Incubation at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the solution for 30 min at 56 °C.

steps.title: Third chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1) to the supernatant and mix.

steps.title: Fourth centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 10 min and keep the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet again
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet with 0.8 × the pellet volume of frozen isopropyl alcohol.

steps.title: Final ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Wash the suspension twice with cold 75 % ethanol (first wash, second wash).
